n_auto_vts.description: Number of virtual terminals automatically activated on boot (0 = disable)

reserve_vt.description: VT number kept reserved for the display manager even when it is not running

kill_user_processes.description: Terminate all processes of a user when their last session exits

kill_only_users.description: If non-empty, only these usernames are subject to process-killing on logout; empty = all users (minus KillExcludeUsers)

kill_exclude_users.description: Usernames whose processes are never killed on logout regardless of KillUserProcesses

inhibit_delay_max_sec.description: Maximum seconds logind waits for inhibitor locks to be released before proceeding with sleep or shutdown

user_stop_delay_sec.description: Seconds to wait before stopping the user's systemd instance after all their sessions have ended

handle_power_key.description: Action on a short power-button press: ignore, poweroff, reboot, halt, kexec, suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-then-hibernate, lock, factory-reset

handle_power_key_long_press.description: Action on a long power-button press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_reboot_key.description: Action on reboot-key press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_reboot_key_long_press.description: Action on long reboot-key press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_suspend_key.description: Action on suspend-key press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_suspend_key_long_press.description: Action on long suspend-key press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_hibernate_key.description: Action on hibernate-key press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_hibernate_key_long_press.description: Action on long hibernate-key press (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_lid_switch.description: Action when the laptop lid is closed while on battery power (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_lid_switch_external_power.description: Action when the lid is closed while on AC/external power (same choices as handle_power_key)

handle_lid_switch_docked.description: Action when the lid is closed with a docking station or second display connected (same choices as handle_power_key)

lid_switch_ignore_inhibited.description: When true, lid-switch actions proceed even if inhibitor locks are held

idle_action_sec.description: Inactivity duration before IdleAction is triggered; accepts systemd time suffixes: s, min, h

idle_action.description: Action taken after IdleActionSec of inactivity (same choices as handle_power_key)

runtime_directory_size.description: Maximum size of each user's /run/user/<uid> tmpfs; accepts a percentage of RAM (e.g. 10%), plain bytes, or a suffix K/M/G

runtime_directory_inodes_max.description: Maximum inode count for /run/user/<uid>; leave empty to let systemd derive it from RuntimeDirectorySize

remove_ipc.description: Remove POSIX IPC objects (shared memory segments, semaphores, message queues) owned by a user when their last session ends

inhibitors_max.description: Maximum number of concurrent systemd-inhibit locks accepted system-wide

sessions_max.description: Maximum number of concurrent user sessions logind will manage

stop_idle_session_sec.description: Forcibly terminate sessions that have been idle for this duration; set to infinity to never auto-terminate
